text: 通用汽车全球高级副总裁兼通用汽车中国及亚洲市场总裁罗煦日前在第九届中国国际进口博览会现场表示，进博会为通用汽车与中国消费者交流、展示对华合作成果提供了平台。中国汽车市场创新活跃，产品研发和更新迭代节奏较快，为公司开展创新与合作带来重要机遇，通用汽车持续看好在中国发展新能源汽车的前景。（新华社）
text_en: Rui Xu, global senior vice president of General Motors and president of GM China and Asian markets, said recently at the 9th China International Import Expo that the expo provides a platform for GM to engage with Chinese consumers and showcase the results of its cooperation with China. China's auto market is highly innovative, with fast-paced product development and iteration, bringing important opportunities for the company's innovation and cooperation, and GM remains bullish on the prospects for developing new energy vehicles in China. (Xinhua News Agency)
